Commentary.Commentary: So, the Dutch have put on a very good total on the board and it will be very difficult for Ireland to chase it down. Can they pull it off? Join us after the break to find out!

Ryan Campbell, the Dutch coach is in for a chat. On the total, Campbell says that he is happy with the total they have on the board. On Ryan's batting along with van der Merwe, Campbell states that that both of them are very experienced players and they inspire others in the side. Says that there were a couple of ups and downs in the tournament but terms this unit as one of the best Dutch sides. Feels that Ireland has a strong batting lineup and defending this total won't be easy but they are looking forward to it.

Boyd Rankin and Gareth Delany were the standout bowlers for Ireland as they kept the run-scoring in check. Both of them bagged a wicket as well. Craig Young was also good as he picked up 2 wickets but his final over in which the Dutch scored 19 runs can prove to be the turning point.

The innings started off slowly for the Dutch as they lost the wickets of Max O'Dowd and Colin Ackermann inside the Powerplay. They scored just 33 off the first 6 overs and Ireland were on top. Skipper Seelar and Ben Cooper steadied the ship but Seelar departed after scoring just 21 runs. Ben Cooper looked sluggish out in the middle and he too departed as he looked to go big in the end. The impetus at the end was provided by Ryan Ten Doeschate and Roelof van der Merwe as they made a quickfire 56-run stand.

Netherlands finish on 158/4 and the momentum is with them going into the second innings as this looks an above par score on this wicket. Ireland lost their bearings a bit in the last 5 overs as they conceded 56 runs.
Around middle and leg, van der Merwe looks to play a scoop down the leg side but gets a tickle as the ball goes towards the wicket keeper for a run. NETHERLAND FINISHEH WITH 158 RUNS ON THE BOARD.
Shortish ball on middle, ten Doeschate pulls and gets a single to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Misfield this time. This should've been just two. Full and around off, ten Doeschate creams this towards mid off where Thompson misfields and the ball goes to the fence.

Dropped! This is a dollly! This one is on the pads, Ryan looks to pummel it over the deep mid-wicket region but could not get the timing right. The ball goes straight in the hands of the fielder there who spills and allows a couple.
Full toss this time, ten Doeschate flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball outside off, van der Merwe tries to smash it off the back foot but the ball goes towards mid off and the batters take one.
SIX! Even bigger this time! Right in the slot on middle, ten Doeschate again clears his front foot and smashes this one over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. 19 off the over.
SIX! Huge! On middle and leg, ten Doeschate gets one leg out of the way and slams this one over the long on fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Beautiful! Length ball on off, ten Doeschate makes room and slaps this over the man at cover for a boundary.
Van der Merwe looks to slap this towards cover but mistimes it and only manages to take one as the ball goes towards short extra cover.
This time a length ball outside off, it is cut to point. Single taken.
Bowls a fuller one on middle, van der Merwe pushes it towards long on for a single.
Craig Young to bowl out. 3-0-20-2 are his figures so far.
Outside off, van der Merwe guides it towards third man but the short third man fielder dives to save runs. Just a single. 11 from the over.
Fuller outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Full on the pads, Roelof this time looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal from the bowler but the umpire is not interested.

FOUR! Van der Merwe gets this off the outer half of the bat but he wouldn't mind it. Another short ball outside off, van der Merwe looks to slap it over the covers again but the ball takes the outer half of the bat and goes over the short third man fielder and into the fence.
Fuller this time, van der Merwe can only push it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Short and outside off, van der Merwe hammers it through covers uppishly. The ball races to the fence in a jiffy.
Mark Adair returns. 2-0-10-0, his figures so far.
Shortish length, pushed towards point.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Another boundary. Delany this time sprays down the pads, van der Merwe flicks it to the fine leg fence.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Another short of length ball, this time van der Merwe connects the pull but not with perfect timing. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder lunges forward to catch the ball but it goes between the hands and into the fence.
Shortish delivery, Ryan goes for the pull but mistimes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, worked towards square leg for a run.
Shortish length outside off, worked over point for a run.
Shortish length on middle, ten Doeschate taps it towards short mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Bouncer! Ryan is early into his pull shot but he misses.
On middle, van der Merwe looks to tuck it towards the leg side but the ball goes towards gully for a single off the outer half of the bat.
Fuller ball around off, nudged towards point for nothing.
Short outside off, Ryan pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Roelof van der Merwe is the next man in. Boyd Rankin returns with the ball for Ireland. 3-0-13-1, Rankin's figures so far.

OUT! BOWLED! Cooper is gone. Excellent bowling by Delany, targetting the stumps, Ben rocks back to cut but is beaten by pace. The ball skids through, misses the bat and hits the leg stump. End of a sluggish knock from Cooper.
Around middle, a touch short, whipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for another single.
Around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Full and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Eases this through mid on for a run.
FOUR! HANDSOME! Full and outside off, ten Doeschate leans and drives it through the covers!
WIDE. Miles outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, Cooper looks to drive but the ball goes off the bottom edge past the bowler towards long off. A single taken.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
ANOTHER WIDE. Full and even further than the previous one, Cooper reaches out to drive but misses.
WIDE. Well outside off, fuller in length and then angling away, left alone.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Stuart Thompson returns. 1-0-9-0 so far.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single. 11 from the over.
SIX! Effortless! Around middle and leg, Cooper comes down the track and sends it sailing over mid-wicket. The fielder runs to his right, sticks his right hand out but the ball sails over!
Outside off, pushed towards point for a run.
Landed outside off, ten Doeschate looks to play the reverse sweep but is beaten. The ball takes the outside edge and goes through the vacant slip region towards third man. Two runs taken.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Dropped short, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Around middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, ten Doeschate pushes it towards cover and sets off for a single.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
The much travelled Ryan ten Doeschate walks in at number 5, replacing Seelaar.

OUT! Caught down the leg side! Rankin has struck. The 44-run stand has been broken. A short ball, down the leg side, Seelaar looks to pull but is cramped for room. The ball goes past and generates a noise. The keeper collects and appeals, followed by the raise of the finger. Guess it was glove.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
WIDE. Slipped down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full and outside off, carved over cover for a couple.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Similar ball, similar shot.
Full and around middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
George Dockrell to bowl now.
Outside off, Cooper looks to cut but gets a top edge which does not carry to sweeper cover. A run taken.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.
Outside off, Seelaar slashes hard and gets a thick outside edge towards third man. A single taken.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, a slash and a miss.
Outside off, lofted over cover for a brace.
Around middle, flicked through square leg for a single.
Craig Young returns.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
Full and outside off, Seelaar looks to sweep but misses. The keeper fumbles and the batsmen take three.
Again, the same shot is attempted, again, the batsman is cramped for room, but this time, the inside edge goes back to the bowler.
Backs away to the leg side, Delany follows him, cramps him for room and all Seelaar can do is push it towards cover.
FOUR! Short and around middle, Seelaar rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket!
A short ball, pulled through fine leg for a single.
Outside off, pretty wide, a slash and a miss.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Seelaar throws his bat at it and gets it over cover. Sweeper dives to his right but cannot get there!
Around middle, almost a yorker, Seelaar loses balance but manages to flick it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Stuart Thompson to bowl now.
The googly, outside off, Ben looks to cut but misses.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Seelaar misses his flick and the keeper fumbles.
Full and down the leg side, swept towards square leg.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Short and around middle, pulled over mid-wicket for a couple.
Gareth Delany to bowl now.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a boundary!
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Pieter Seelaar is the captain of the Netherlands team and is out in the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Waste of a wicket. Ackermann, after getting across on the previous ball, moves leg side this time. Exposes all the three sticks, challenging Young to hit. Young accepts the challenge, fires in a yorker and misses Ackermann's bat. Misses the off stump. Misses the leg stump. Hits middle.

FOUR! How did he get that in that region? A length ball, around off, Ackermann gets across to paddle. But the bowler has dished out a slower one. So, the batsman has to wait for the ball to come to him but he is already through his shot. The bat is already swung and just when it completes its rotation, the ball makes contact. Hits the back of the bat and flies over short third man to the fence!
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, tapped to cover for a quick run.

DIRECT HIT! SAFE! Boy, that was close. Around off, Cooper pushed it towards the off side and set off for a single. Stuart Thompson came running in and scored a direct hit at the bowler's end. Now, Cooper was taking it lightly and did not ground his bat. In fact, his foot was just on the ground and in the crease when the ball hit the stumps.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Boyd Rankin comes on again.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Colin Ackermann walks in at number 3.

OUT! Excellent catch! There goes the first wicket. A length ball, around of, O'Dowd looks to tuck it to the leg side but the ball moves sideways, takes the leading edge and goes to point. Harry Tector at point dives forward and takes it!
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
A short ball outside off, O'Dowd looks to pull but misses.
Works this through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Clean hitting. A length ball, around off, O'Dowd lofts it over mid on and gets a boundary!

Out, gone! No? How did that miss the bat? How did that miss the stumps? Gem of a delivery. Adair lands this on a length around off and then gets it to seam away. There is a noise as the ball goes past but it has missed the edge and the stumps. Perhaps hit the pad.
Around middle and leg, helped through square leg for a run.

In the air... just short! Full and around middle, O'Dowd looks to go over the top but cannot quite get the timing on it. Kevin O'Brien gets across to his left from mid on and gets down but the ball lands in front of him. A single taken.
Outside off, chipped over covers for three runs.
Works this down the leg side for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Outside off, eased straight to cover.
Full and outside off, Cooper pushes inside the line but misses as the ball moves away.
Full and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Boyd Rankin to share the new ball with Adair.
Outside off, O'Dowd pushes it towards cover and sets off for a quick single. George Dockrell comes charging in and under-arms a shy at the striker's end but misses. Cooper was a goner.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Landed outside off, Max comes down the track and has a wild swing, but misses.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Outside off, steered towards third man for a single.

That is a snorter first up! A jaffa to get things underway. Adair lands it on a length outside off and then makes it shoot up. O'Dowd is caught by surprise as he looks to fend at it, takes his eyes off totally, is in the air while trying to play that and has no control.The ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. A single taken.
The players are out in the middle. Max O'Dowd and Ben Cooper to start off proceedings for the Dutch. Here comes Mark Adair to O'Dowd with a slip in place.
PITCH REPORT - Bazid Khan looks at the surface and predicts bounce. Expects turn as well.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien, Gareth Delany, Mark Adair, Andrew Balbirnie, Harry Tector, Gary Wilson(c and wk), Craig Young, George Dockrell, Boyd Rankin and Stuart Thompson.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Max O'Dowd, Ben Cooper, Colin Ackermann, Ryan ten Doeschate, Pieter Seelaar(c), Scott Edwards(wk), Roelof van der Merwe, Timm van der Gugten, Fred Klaassen, Brandon Glover and Paul van Meekeren.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and ELECTED TO CHASE.

6 teams to go into the World T20 in 2020. All 6 decided. What is left? Well, positions. Scotland finished 5th yesterday and today, it is about those who can finish 1 or 2. Hello and a warm welcome to the first semi-final between Ireland and Netherlands in Dubai.
